scripts.dev:bundled: pnpm --workspace-root run runtime:prepare && cross-env DSH_DESKTOP_VARIANT=bundled tauri dev --config tauri.bundled.conf.json
scripts.build:bundled: pnpm --workspace-root run runtime:prepare && cross-env DSH_DESKTOP_VARIANT=bundled tauri build --config tauri.bundled.conf.json && pnpm --workspace-root run bundle:label bundled
scripts.build:slim: cross-env DSH_DESKTOP_VARIANT=slim tauri build --config tauri.slim.conf.json && pnpm --workspace-root run bundle:label slim
